name: assess_observation
description: Sends what the farmer sees on their plants now and their answers; returns what is still to be asked (information_needs) or guidance. Use only if the plot got worse.

user_statement.description: What the farmer describes now, in their own words

symptoms.description: Concrete symptoms they mentioned, for example 'yellow spots on leaves'

items.description: One concrete symptom, for example 'yellow spots on leaves'

answers.description: All the answers to needs in this call

value.description: Answer normalized by answer_type (text, number or true/false). Omit if they don't know

unit.description: Unit if the answer is a number, for example 'd' for days

raw_text.description: What the farmer said, word for word

unknown.description: true if the farmer doesn't know

asked_need_codes.description: need_code of everything already asked in this call
